medium: science explainer: flat diagrams on dark green, flat science illustrations, real-world footage, cut into a presenter at home
avoid: 3D render, stick figures, glossy stock imagery, neon, gradients on flat panels, legible text
note: Presenter on camera (studio and selfie-walk) is non-generatable. Four generatable looks.

looks.label: Presenter at home
looks.when: the creator on camera — never generated.

looks.label: Selfie walk outdoors
looks.when: the creator filming herself outside — never generated.

looks.label: Flat diagram on dark green
looks.when: how something works — optics, forces, a mechanism — drawn as a simple labelled diagram.
looks.prompt: A clean flat diagram on a dark forest-green ground: a few simple shapes in pink, yellow and white with thick black outlines, thin yellow lines showing rays or forces, one labelled part as illegible marks, generous empty space. Cheerful, textbook-simple.

looks.label: Flat science illustration
looks.when: molecules, chemistry, a process at a scale you can't film — drawn flat and bright.
looks.prompt: A bright flat illustration of a scientific idea: simple coloured spheres and zigzag chains for molecules, or icon-style objects (a bottle, a pH meter, a bar of soap) with a plus sign between them, on a soft blue or white ground, clean edges, no text.

looks.label: Real-world footage
looks.when: a phenomenon that exists in the world — a flock, waves, a landscape — shown as filmed footage.
looks.prompt: Photographic footage of a natural phenomenon at a distance — a murmuration of birds against a dusk sky, a rocky shoreline with waves, a wide landscape — muted natural colour, soft light, no people close to camera, no text.

looks.label: Stacked photo-strip list
looks.when: a list of examples or applications — each item a labelled photo band stacked vertically.
looks.prompt: Four to five horizontal photo bands stacked top to bottom filling the frame, each a different real-world scene, each with a short label in white sans-serif at its right edge as the caption, thin dark gaps between bands.
